items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) will not travel to London and is ruled OUT for Sunday vs Jaguars, along with WR Tank Dell (knee) and S Jalen Pitre (shoulder).
items.why: Groin injury; no travel for London game.
items.implication: Backfield opportunity opens for handcuff/backup; Texans run game diminished.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/snaps for remaining Texans RBs like Woody Marks or others.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts is OUT for Week 6 vs Panthers (and indefinitely) due to a superficial blood clot in his calf that showed movement on follow-up ultrasound; Tanner McKee will start. Health and safety prioritized after initial clearance to play in London.
items.why: Follow-up ultrasound revealed movement in small superficial blood clot discovered after calf cleat; treatment course TBD, possibly blood thinners preventing play.
items.implication: McKee starts; Eagles offense changes; Hurts owners need immediate QB replacement; pass-catchers may see volume shifts.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for backup QB and potentially more checkdowns to TEs/RBs if McKee is conservative.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley did not practice again Thursday; DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited practice. Combined with Hurts OUT, Eagles may be without multiple stars vs Panthers.
items.implication: Game-time or OUT risk for Barkley; Smith trending up but limited. Handcuffs elevated.
items.opportunity: Dameon Pierce or other backups for Barkley; Wicks/Cooper for Smith if limited/OUT.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice did not practice again Thursday due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Questionable or worse for Week 6; stash value if multi-week.
items.opportunity: More targets to Worthy/others if OUT.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson officially did not practice again Thursday (ankle).
items.implication: Status uncertain for Week 6; backup likely if continues.
items.opportunity: Huntley or other if OUT; Ravens pass catchers risk without Lamar.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams full participant second straight day, on track to start vs Falcons. Kyle Monangai likely misses second straight.
items.implication: Expected to start; Bears offense stabilized.
items.opportunity: Normal usage for Bears skill players.

items.text: Cardinals trade Marvin Harrison Jr. to HOU. Levitan/Silva: Kendrick Bourne will get open more and earn more targets than MHJ did.
items.why: Trade fallout discussion; Bourne projected higher target efficiency in ARI.
items.implication: MHJ to HOU offense; Bourne waiver/start bump in ARI.
items.opportunity: Bourne routes/targets up; MHJ new team role TBD.

items.text: Since Breece Hall injury (week-to-week, no practice), RB snaps in two full games: Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Kene Nwangwu 0. Allen is the clear workhorse.
items.why: Snap counts show Allen dominating backfield without Hall.
items.implication: Allen is must-start RB while Hall out; Hall stash.
items.opportunity: Near-every-down role for Allen; high carry/target share.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty said he is feeling great and this is the best he’s felt this season.
items.why: Player comments on feeling best of season.

items.text: 49ers opened the practice window for WR Christian Kirk (calf) on IR.
items.why: Calf injury; window opened to begin practicing.
items.implication: Potential return soon; depth for 49ers WRs.

items.text: Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins, McNabb, McCoy, Ertz etc.). Saquon Barkley turns 30 in Feb; if Super Bowl contender with RB need, I'd at least call.
items.why: Age + Eagles precedent for preemptively moving veterans; current DNP adds context.
items.implication: Long-term trade value risk or opportunity for contenders; monitor Eagles RB depth.
items.opportunity: Potential landing spot boost if traded to contender.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans (WR4) vs WSH Commanders secondary; also loves Drake London (WR6) vs CHI, Matthew Golden (WR11), George Kittle (TE3) vs WSH. Soft matchups and usage.
items.why: WSH defense buffet for pass catchers; London/Golden bankable usage.
items.opportunity: High target/snap potential in favorable matchups.

items.text: HATES Jaylen Waddle (WR28) vs SEA, Emeka Egbuka (WR34) vs PIT, Kyle Pitts (TE18) vs CHI; also Bo Nix (QB23) vs SEA, Justin Herbert (QB25) @ KC. Ugly matchups/QB issues/volume.
items.why: Tough defenses, shaky QB situations, low volume lately for WRs/TEs; Nix toughest pass D, Herbert low totals.

items.text: Ravens WR Ja'Kobi Lane expected to return to practice (4 weeks post wrist surgery), has shot to play this weekend. Round 3 rookie had huge camp buzz, returns to elite 6.4 YPP offense even with Lamar missing snaps.
items.why: Per Garafolo/RapSheet; camp standout who could challenge Bateman; elite offense efficiency.
items.implication: Deep league stash/add; potential role in Ravens WR corps.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets in high-YPP offense if active.
